_help.about: Edit this file to control the promotional items shown on the free version. Everything is hidden automatically while the Pro add-on is active.
_help.enabled: Master switch. false hides every promo item.
_help.show_close: true = items have a close (x) button. false = no close button, the item always stays. Can also be set per slot.
_help.remember_dismiss: Only matters when the close button is shown. true = a closed item stays closed (see reshow_days). false = closing only hides it until the next page refresh, so it appears again every time. Can also be set per slot.
_help.slots: header_text = text in the centre of the top bar. builder_box = box under 'Save as default for new popups' in the builder. dashboard_slider = sliding images in a movable Dashboard box (drag it like the other boxes; its height follows the slides). menu_item = extra link at the end of the ZapPopPop admin menu.
_help.per slot: enabled (true/false), start and end (YYYY-MM-DD, optional schedule), show_close (true/false, overrides the top-level value), remember_dismiss (optional, overrides the top-level value), reshow_days (a closed item appears again after this many days; 0 = only when its id or content changes), id (optional; change it to show a closed item again).
_help.fields:
title, text (links , , ,
allowed), cta (button label), url, new_tab (true/false), image (file name of an image placed in this defaults/ folder, e.g. slide1.jpg, or a full URL), image_url (optional: clicking the image opens this URL), image_new_tab (optional true/false; default follows new_tab).
_help.colors: text_color, bg_color, cta_text_color, cta_bg_color: hex values such as #ffffff. Leave empty to use the Theme page colours. Slides inherit the slot colours unless they set their own.
_help.dashboard_slider: interval = milliseconds between slides. slides = list of entries with the fields above (maximum 8).
_help.menu_item: text = menu label (default Go PRO), url = where it links, text_color and bg_color = menu item colours.
_help.note: JSON does not allow comments or trailing commas. Keys starting with an underscore are ignored. Put images (png, jpg, gif, webp, svg, avif) in this defaults/ folder.
_help.plugin_link: Link on the Plugins screen, right after 'Deactivate'. text = label (default Go PRO), url = where it links, new_tab (true/false), text_color = hex colour of the text (empty = Theme primary colour). enabled=false removes it.
_help.image_fit: Dashboard slider images: auto (default) = the image fills the full width and its height follows the image size, so the box grows or shrinks to fit; text and button are drawn on top of the image. cover = fixed box height, the image is cropped to fill it. Set image_fit on the slot or on a single slide.
_help.pro_extensions: Static Pro cards at the bottom of ZapPopPop > Extend. title and text = heading and intro, cta = text of the orange button on every card, url = where the button goes (new_tab honoured; empty url = the button only opens the upgrade dialog). cta_bg_color / cta_text_color change the button colours (default orange / white). items = list of {slug, name, description, icon (a dashicons class), badge (max 12)}, up to 24. An item whose slug is already a real module on the site is skipped. Closable like the other slots (show_close, reshow_days).
_help.builder_pro_settings: Static locked rows after the accordions in the builder Popup Settings drawer. Same fields as pro_extensions (title, text, items). Nothing in them is saved. Each item may carry "controls": [{type: toggle|select|number|text|textarea|color|range, label, value, options, on}], up to 8, drawn greyed-out inside the accordion. Nothing is saved. Hover button: overlay_text (default "Upgrade to PRO"), overlay_url (default = url), overlay_new_tab, overlay_action = "link" (default, goes straight to overlay_url) or "popup" (opens the upgrade dialog). Empty overlay_url and url = no button. (default)
_help.upgrade_popup:
The dialog that opens when a locked card or row is clicked. title (use {name} for the clicked item name), text (links , , ,
allowed), features = list of short lines (max 8), cta + url + new_tab = the upgrade button, close_text = label of the second button (default Not now), image, and the colours text_color / bg_color / cta_text_color / cta_bg_color. enabled=false turns the dialog off: the teasers then show the cta as a plain link. show_close / remember_dismiss / reshow_days work as on the other slots: X and "Not now" snooze the dialog in this browser for reshow_days (0 = until site data is cleared; remember_dismiss=false = until the next page refresh; show_close=false = no X and nothing is remembered). after_close = what a click on a locked item does while snoozed: "none" or "link" (goes to url).
_help._label: Every slot has a "_label" naming the area it controls. It is for you only; the plugin ignores it.
